name: PICAR Tools Distribution System
summary: A desktop application built for PICAR to manage tool inventory, sales, purchases, customers, suppliers, accounts, payments, and operational reports.
functions: Manages tools and products, stock, customer and supplier accounts, purchases, sales, payments, checks, and reports from one local application.
problem: PICAR needed to replace disconnected records with a reliable system for controlling tool inventory and the commercial activity linked to customers and suppliers.
solution: I developed a tailored desktop application that centralizes product loading, stock movements, sales, purchases, account balances, payment control, alerts, and reporting.
